title: Onboarding slide offset

implementation.change: Move the computed slide offset from inline translateX transform to a CSS recipe using native translate. Phase offset arithmetic and configured 300 ms duration are retained.

limits: Actual healthy Local first-run has three phases. Genuine Next/Back plus documented preview Hello/Back cover the changed shared slide. Four-phase backend addition/4-to-3 collapse is covered by existing functional unit and compiled CSS guards, not claimed as live backend-down/public authentication proof.
Before transform matrices and After individual CSS translate are normalized through actual element rectangles; transform text identity is not expected.
0.3s is configured computed CSS duration; asynchronous saves, capture sampling and wall-clock video timing are not claimed exact or identical.
No model configured, no model calls or credentials entered.
The standalone Local captures cover all five current themes at desktop 1440×1000 and phone 390×844. No Cloud, ACP or arbitrary embedded-host UI pass is claimed.
Getting started remains expanded behind every preview capture in both phases. Fresh first-run captures are separately labelled and establish only their genuine Agent/Setup sequence.
Actual UI pixels are unretouched. Separate editorial banners identify ownership and capture mode; all complete original clips and selected full-viewport PNGs are downloadable.

This change moves style ownership without claiming a performance improvement or literal whole-screen pixel identity. All source clips are 25 fps; output retains original playback timing without motion interpolation.
